Toggle Menu The Fuzz Revolutionary fuzz/distortion pedal with wave guide technology and 3-band EQ for versatile tones from vintage blues to modern metal. Add to cart More details · Find a dealer Revolutionary wave guide technology with Deep and High controls works in conjunction with 3-band EQ to shape and clean up distortion in previously impossible ways. Exceptional tonal versatility ranges from vintage blues fuzz to mid-80s hard rock to hardcore metal sounds, all from one pedal with precise control. Wave guide controls allow cleaning up distortion while maintaining character, providing clarity and definition even at extreme gain settings for articulate heavy tones. Built-in regulated ±12V power supply enables highest quality circuitry design with maximum headroom for dynamic response and low-noise operation. Sets new standards for distortion pedals by combining classic fuzz character with modern tone-shaping flexibility and studio-grade sound quality. Carl Martin The Fuzz Add to cart Find a dealer All about Carl Martin The Fuzz Carl Martin The FUZZ Sets new standards for distortion with it´s revolutionary wave guide. By using the wave guide’s deep and high controls in conjunction with the 3 band EQ, it is possible to clean up the distortion and shape the sound in any way needed thus making it possible to achieve sounds ranging from an old blues fuzz, to a mid 80’s hard rock tone, to a hard core metal sound. The Fuzz has a built in regulated (+-12V) power supply. This enables us to design circuitry of the highest quality with maximum headroom. Specifications No specifications added yet.
